title: freemuxlet
description:
Freemuxlet is a software tool to deconvolute sample identity and identify multiplets when
multiple samples are pooled by barcoded single cell sequencing. If external genotyping
data is not available, the genotyping-free version demuxlet, freemuxlet, would be recommended.

plp.description: Prefix of input files generated by dsc-pileup

init_cluster.description: Input file containing the initial cluster information.

aux_files.description: Turn on writing auxilary output files

verbose.description: Turn on verbose mode with specific verbosity threshold. 0: fully verbose, 100 : no verbose messages.

bf_thres.description: Bayes Factor Threshold used in the initial clustering.

frac_init_clust.description: Fraction of droplets to be clustered in the very first round of initial clustering procedure.

iter_init.description: Iteration for initial cluster assignment (set to zero to skip the iterations).

keep_init_missing.description: Keep missing cluster assignment as missing in the initial iteration.

randomize_singlet_score.description: Randomize the singlet scores to test its effect.

seed.description: Seed for random number (use clocks if not set).

cap_bq.description: Maximum base quality (higher BQ will be capped).

min_bq.description: Minimum base quality to consider (lower BQ will be skipped).

group_list.description: List of tag readgroup/cell barcode to consider in this run. All other barcodes will be ignored. This is useful for parallelized run.

min_total.description: Minimum number of total reads for a droplet/cell to be considered.

min_umi.description: Minimum number of UMIs for a droplet/cell to be considered.

min_snp.description: Minimum number of SNPs with coverage for a droplet/cell to be considered.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
